chapters.label: The cross, live
chapters.text: Spain against Argentina, the 2026 World Cup final. Pedro Porro whips a deep cross in from the right... Nico Williams heads it back. Ferran Torres smashes it in!

chapters.label: The whip
chapters.text: Watch it again. Porro whips it high, away from the keeper and over the defenders.

chapters.label: Headed back
chapters.text: Williams heads it back. Torres runs onto it, and with his left foot, slams it into the roof of the net. The winning goal!

chapters.label: The secret
chapters.text: The secret? Whip the cross into the space between the keeper and the defenders, where your teammates can attack it.
